descriptor_distance — SHAPE2D descriptor op

• Data kinds: efdmodel × efdmodel → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.descriptor_distance(m1, m2, n_harmonics=None, scale_invariant=True) (to call the implementation directly, import fourierdesc; fourierdesc.descriptor_distance(m1, m2, n_harmonics=None, scale_invariant=True); from the registry, opsshape2d.get("descriptor_distance"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

2 つの形状間の距離(小さいほど似た形)。回転/平行移動/始点/(任意で)スケール不変。

各高調波の楕円 (長軸, 短軸) 特異値不変量(:func:invariants)の L2 距離。

m1, m2 は :func:elliptic_fourier の出力 dict。
